rows: A study can involve three organisations without merging their users, contracts or data permissions.
An unverified applicant can prepare an application but cannot authorise data access or approve studies.
Cross organisation searches, direct links, exports and background jobs all reject ungranted access.
Two programmes can apply different eligibility and funding rules to the same product.
Accepting a study invitation grants only the study permissions specified in the approved agreement.
Removing the last accountable owner is blocked until an authorised successor accepts responsibility.
Suspension blocks new activity while preserving authorised incident response and required evidence access.
A country administrator cannot change another country's rules or weaken mandatory operator controls.
Historical reports retain the original legal entity and show the effective transfer date.
A demo administrator cannot connect a production dataset or issue a production evidence report.
An expired or already accepted invitation cannot create another membership.
Each accepted write and approval is attributable to one uniquely identified human or service principal.

Study type determines required gates and allowable exposure of outputs to clinical users.
An underpowered subgroup is labelled inconclusive rather than represented as proven safe.
Threshold changes after results are viewed create a protocol amendment and disclosed exploratory analysis.
An evaluator cannot silently remove model failures from the primary denominator.
A comparison using different populations must disclose the limitation and cannot imply a controlled head to head result.

Final results link to the frozen plan and identify all departures from it.

A high risk clinical use cannot enter through a low risk administrative template.

Every reported metric identifies its definition, implementation version and denominator.
Predictive values state the observed or assumed prevalence and are not transferred without qualification.
Repeated observations from one patient are not treated as independent without justification.

All attempted cases reconcile across scored, abstained, rejected and failed categories.

A benefit claim identifies both absolute and relative differences where relevant.

English performance cannot substitute for evidence in another advertised clinical language.
Successful bypasses are recorded with impact and remediation evidence without releasing sensitive attack artefacts publicly.
A test agent cannot issue a real prescription, contact a patient or modify a live record without the separately authorised workflow.
An unvalidated model judge cannot be the sole basis for a final clinical safety decision.

Results retain linkage to the correct examination and evaluated image series.
A summary evaluation can identify clinically material omissions from the authorised source record.

A cost effectiveness calculation states perspective, currency, price year, assumptions and uncertainty.
No recruitment or care affecting evaluation can begin at an inactive site.

A deviation affecting participant safety triggers escalation independently of ordinary data cleaning.
Monitoring findings have accountable corrective actions and verifiable closure evidence.
A report initiates safety review without waiting for causality to be proven.
A study cannot be marked fully closed while mandatory follow up obligations remain unassigned.

No clinical use proceeds with an unaccepted material residual risk.

An unacknowledged instruction remains visibly unresolved and escalates to local contacts.
An implicated party cannot alter retained evidence or close its own independent investigation.
Closing an action requires verification evidence rather than a completion checkbox alone.

Commercial pressure or payment status cannot override an active safety hold.

Repeated low severity incidents can trigger a systemic risk review.

Paid participation cannot silently change procurement ranking or evaluation criteria.

A pilot nearing funding expiry shows an accountable continuation or closure decision.

Recent unlabelled cases cannot be counted as successful outcomes.

A developer cannot unilaterally declare a material clinical change insignificant.
An overdue required revalidation produces an explicit restricted or expired evidence status.
Unacknowledged urgent alerts reach the backup contact within the configured escalation period.
Central issuance does not imply a site completed rollback without positive confirmation.

A funder sees approved programme outcomes without receiving patient records by default.

Reported turnaround includes a published rule for paused and abandoned studies.
